description: Read actor-safe outcome and result metrics for one order. The server derives the actor side from current order membership; if the actor has both memberships in the order, the CREATOR projection is used. Optional ISO from/to timestamps bound the period; from must precede to. No other participant’s fees or net amounts are returned. Requires read scope. The Public API applies current tenant, role, account-access, and object permissions. Pass only IDs returned to this API key; the server derives the acting user and account.
name: vibevo_get_placement_order_analytics
title: Get placement order analytics
